What Is Multiwatch?

Multiwatch is the practice of watching several live streams at the same time in one place, instead of flipping between separate browser tabs. A good multiwatch setup keeps every stream visible so you never lose track of what is happening across an event.

TooManyStreams: A Free Multiwatch Tool

TooManyStreams gives you a free way to multiwatch Twitch and YouTube streams together. Add the channels you care about, drop them into a stream wall, and keep everything visible in a single browser tab instead of juggling windows.

Build Your Own Multiwatch Stream Wall

Every multiwatch session is different. TooManyStreams lets you add and remove streams, drag them into the layout you want, and reshape your stream wall as an event evolves, so your multiwatch view always matches what you are following.

Multiwatch Esports, Tournaments, and Creator Events

Multiwatch setups shine during esports tournaments, creator collabs, and community events with several points of view. TooManyStreams keeps casters, players, and official broadcasts together so you can multiwatch the full story as it happens.

Switch Audio Without Breaking Your Multiwatch View

When you multiwatch multiple streams, only one can have your attention at a time. TooManyStreams lets you set a main stream for audio while the rest keep playing silently in view, so you can focus without shrinking your multiwatch layout.
